caption: A robot vacuum finishes cleaning and drives onto its charging dock, and a charging light on the dock comes on.

sa.check: A robot vacuum on a floor, and its charging dock.
The robot drives onto the dock and comes to rest against it.
A light on the dock comes on.
The robot is driving about the floor before it heads to the dock.
The light is on the dock, not on the robot.
The order is drive, dock, light.

pc.expect: The dock light is off while the robot is away and comes on when the robot comes to rest against the dock, and only then.
pc.fail: The robot sits on the dock and the light stays off; or the light is on while the robot is still crossing the floor; or the light comes on as the robot passes by without stopping at the dock.

pc.expect: Once the robot is seated the light stays on for the rest of the clip while the robot stays on the dock.
pc.fail: The light goes out again with the robot still seated on the dock; or the robot leaves the dock and the light stays lit; or the light shifts from the dock to a spot on the robot.

pc.expect: The robot rolls across the floor on its wheels and comes to rest with its front against the dock.
pc.fail: The robot lifts off the floor as it nears the dock; or rides up on top of the dock; or slides sideways with its body facing away from its direction of travel.

pc.expect: The dock stays in place on the floor as the robot arrives; nothing else in the room moves.
pc.fail: The dock slides or turns by itself before the robot reaches it; or the dock jumps to a new spot; or furniture or rugs shift as the robot docks.

pc.expect: One robot and one dock; the robot keeps its body and does not pass into the dock or the wall.
pc.fail: The robot vanishes or a second robot appears; or the robot merges into the dock; or the robot passes through the wall or a piece of furniture; or the dock changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The floor pattern, the robot's colour and the dock's shape stay the same.
pc.fail: The robot changes colour; or the floor pattern changes; or the dock light moves to a different place on the dock.

note: The robot is a self-driven machine: its turning, slowing and stopping are not causeless motion. 'Finishes cleaning' is read as the robot driving on the floor before it heads to the dock.
